attributes.action: Protect free sports facilities for young people
attributes.background: To maintain low-costs sport facilities and pitches like Astro turf to maintain the youth of today’s health whilst also providing a benefit to their social life. It would boots sport involvement and keeping kids off technology and help them develop as a person

rejection.details: This is principally a matter for local authorities or other organisations who fund local sports facilities.  It also isn't clear whether you are talking about facilities that are free to use ( as per the title) or ones that are low cost (as per the text).
